title: MoE Ethiopian Exit Exam: Information Science (2015)
description: Official Ministry of Education (MoE) Ethiopian University Exit Examination for Information Science (2015). Complete with detailed explanations.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is the primary access point to the bibliographic record?
questions.explanation: The main entry is the primary access point to the bibliographic record.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not library automation software?
questions.explanation: Ardinio is not recognized as library automation software.

questions.questionText: Why is the organization of recorded information necessary?
options: Printed and non-printed media of information are increasing extremely
To provide structured access to information
To differentiate what is not exactly alike
questions.explanation: All of the options are valid reasons for organizing recorded information: the exponential growth of information resources (option A), providing structured access to information (option B), and enabling differentiation between similar but not identical resources (option C).

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not true about the function in C++?
options: Function name can start with number
Function prototype should be scripted before the main function, if function definition is not done before main function
The number and type of arguments should match the number of function parameters
Using a function involves calling it.
questions.explanation: Function names cannot start with a number in C++.

questions.questionText: What will be the output of the following C++ function: int main() { register int i = 1; int *ptr = &i; cout << *ptr; return 0; }
questions.explanation: The output will be 1, as it dereferences the pointer to the variable i.

questions.questionText: ___________ is that phase of the cataloging process that is concerned with the identification and description of an information resource.
questions.explanation: Descriptive cataloging focuses on identifying and describing information resources.

questions.questionText: Given an IP address of 131.107.2.160 and a subnet mask of 255.255.255.192, to which subnet does the host belong?
questions.explanation: With a subnet mask of 255.255.255.192, the subnet bits are the first 2 bits of the last octet (192 = 11000000 in binary). For IP 131.107.2.160 (160 = 10100000 in binary), these first 2 bits are '10' which equals decimal 2. The subnet ID is calculated by multiplying this by 64 (the block size for a /26 network): 2×64 = 128. Therefore, the subnet is 131.107.2.128.

questions.questionText: In a relevance feedback approach, the usage of relevance feedback methods without explicit user involvement is:
questions.explanation: Pseudo relevance feedback is used without explicit user involvement.

questions.questionText: Which step is correct in library automation?
questions.explanation: The correct sequence is planning, design, operation, implementation, and evaluation.

questions.questionText: To generate the output of a query a ________ is responsible.
questions.explanation: The query execution engine is responsible for generating the output of a query.

questions.questionText: Which audio file format is used for Macintosh?
questions.explanation: .AIFF is the audio file format used for Macintosh.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is correct HTML to create a hyperlink?
questions.explanation: The correct HTML for a hyperlink is Visit MWU.

questions.questionText: From the following which one is false regarding the information science concept?
options: Information retrieval (IR) is the process of finding material (usually documents) of an unstructured nature (usually text) that satisfies an information need from within large collections (usually stored on computers)
Information seeking is a major constituent of information behavior or information practices, that is, the entirety of ways in which people seek, use, and share information in different contexts.
Information explosion is the unabated, exponential growth of information and information records, particularly in science and technology
questions.explanation: None of the statements are false; all the given statements accurately describe information science concepts. The correct answer should have been 'None of the above' rather than 'All of the above'.

questions.questionText: Which one is demanding primary key values not to assume a NULL value?
questions.explanation: Entity integrity requires that primary key values cannot be NULL.

questions.questionText: Which statement correctly describes data retrieval?
options: Is concerned with retrieving information about a subject or topic rather than retrieving data which satisfies a given query
The retrieved objects might be inaccurate in data retrieval
It consists mainly of determining which documents contain a set of keywords in the user query
Errors are tolerated in data retrieval
questions.explanation: Data retrieval primarily focuses on determining which documents contain relevant keywords.

questions.questionText: For an IP address - 120.6.12.200, the binary value for the network address is:
questions.explanation: The binary representation of 120.6.12.200 is 01111000.00000110.00001100.11001000, which is the network address in binary form.

questions.questionText: __________ is bringing all the same information together and also in pinpointing the differences and assist the user in selecting from the alternatives.
questions.explanation: Organizing information helps in bringing together similar information and highlighting differences.

questions.questionText: Which transmission media has the highest transmission speed in network?
questions.explanation: Optical fiber has the highest transmission speed among the listed media.

questions.questionText: From the following one is infrastructure for systems for the organization of knowledge.
questions.explanation: All options represent infrastructure for organizing knowledge.

questions.questionText: Which statement is true about XML?
options: An XML document can have one root element
An XML document can have one child element
XML elements have to be in lowercase
questions.explanation: An XML document must have one root element.

questions.questionText: For the following given index, determine documents retrieved by the Boolean model based IR system. Query: K2 or not (K1 and K3)
questions.explanation: The query 'K2 OR NOT(K1 AND K3)' retrieves documents that either contain K2 OR do not contain both K1 and K3 together. This would result in documents D1, D2, D3, D4, D5, and D6, assuming standard Boolean retrieval semantics.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is the correct general format of CSS?
questions.explanation: The correct format for CSS is Selector{property:value;}

questions.questionText: One of the following is not an Information retrieval system.
questions.explanation: Google Chrome is a web browser, not an information retrieval system.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is illegal?
questions.explanation: The declaration 'int i; double*dp=&i' is illegal because you cannot assign the address of an int variable to a double pointer due to type mismatch.

questions.questionText: Which of the following correctly declares an array in C++?
questions.explanation: The correct way to declare an array in C++ is 'int array[10];'.

questions.questionText: Almanacs belong to_________________.
questions.explanation: Almanacs are considered tertiary sources.

questions.questionText: The 4 byte IP address consists of:
questions.explanation: A 4 byte IP address consists of both network and host addresses.

questions.questionText: Inverted file provides the information related to the location of each term within the document; why is it helpful?
questions.explanation: Inverted files are helpful for proximity-based ranking of terms.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is true about Visual Basic programming?
options: GUI is a mechanism for interacting with a computer operating system
CLI provides windows, pull-down menus, buttons, scrollbars, other icons
The Label control is used to display text that can be changed directly by the user.
questions.explanation: All statements are true regarding Visual Basic programming.

questions.questionText: __________ serves as a bridge between the user's information need and the material in the collection.
questions.explanation: A knowledge organization system bridges the user's needs and available materials.

questions.questionText: Why organize information in libraries or information centers?
options: Preparation for examination, for good result, requires organized reading
To give good service to readers
questions.explanation: All options highlight the importance of organizing information in libraries.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is true about information?
options: A vital resource for individuals, businesses, non-business organizations and communities
Accurate, timely, and relevant information saves both time and money through increased efficiency, improved productivity, and rapid deployment of innovations
The availability of information everywhere has led to a rapid, accelerated pace of change in the world
questions.explanation: All statements are true regarding the importance of information.

questions.questionText: Single-line comments in C# start with two forward slashes (//).
questions.explanation: Single-line comments in C# indeed start with two forward slashes (//).

questions.questionText: The process of correcting errors from the program via testing is:
questions.explanation: Debugging is the process of correcting errors in a program.

questions.questionText: From the following one is not the purpose of computer in library:
options: Searching of social media for information
questions.explanation: Searching social media for information is not a primary purpose of computers in libraries.

questions.questionText: Before designing a new automated system, what is better to be studied?
questions.explanation: Studying the existing system is crucial before designing a new automated system as it helps understand current workflows, identify weaknesses, recognize strengths, and establish requirements for the new system.

questions.questionText: At what level does the permission to have access to a specific relation provide security in RDBMS?
questions.explanation: In RDBMS, security for accessing specific relations (tables) is provided at the Relational level. View level security provides access to specific views, which are derived from relations, but not to the relations themselves.

questions.questionText: In which loop are we sure that the body of the loop will be executed at least once even if the condition is not satisfied?
questions.explanation: A do while loop guarantees at least one execution of the loop body.

questions.questionText: Which one is not correct initialization of an array?
questions.explanation: Option B is incorrect because it initializes an array of size 5 with 6 elements.

questions.questionText: What is C++?
options: C++ is an object-oriented programming language
C++ is a procedural programming language
C++ supports both procedural and object-oriented programming languages
C++ is a functional programming language
questions.explanation: C++ supports both procedural and object-oriented programming paradigms. It was designed as an extension of C (procedural) with the addition of object-oriented features like classes, inheritance, polymorphism, and encapsulation.

questions.questionText: In a relational database, data is stored in______
questions.explanation: Data in a relational database is stored in tables.

questions.questionText: Computer software belongs to________________.
questions.explanation: Computer software does not fit into primary, secondary, or tertiary sources.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following secondary storage devices is suitable for archival purposes?
questions.explanation: Magnetic tape is commonly used for archival storage due to its longevity.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a computer program that manages or controls the access to centralized resources or services in a network?
questions.explanation: A server manages access to centralized resources in a network.

questions.questionText: Which of the following image file formats is a standard for photographic image compression?
questions.explanation: JPEG is the standard format for photographic image compression.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a valid variable name?
questions.explanation: Student_ID is a valid variable name in programming.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following are features of library automation?
options: Simple, clear search interface for all users
questions.explanation: All options (simple search interface, multilingual support, and import/export capabilities) are features of library automation systems.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements best describes data transmission?
options: The process of removing data from one specific location
The transferring data from one point to another
The process of securing data in a network
questions.explanation: Data transmission refers to the transfer of data from one point to another.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is false about C#?
options: A Label is a way to output some text on the form
A TextBox can be used to output data and provide a way for the user to enter text
The Pointer is not a control
questions.explanation: None of the statements about C# are false. Labels display text, TextBoxes allow both input and output, and Pointer is indeed not a standard control in C#.

questions.questionText: Among the issues in Information Retrieval system, which one refers to the difference between low-level features of documents and high-level concepts that are relevant to the user's information need?
questions.explanation: The semantic gap refers to the difference between low-level features and high-level concepts.

questions.questionText: The standard command to write output in JavaScript is:
questions.explanation: The standard command to write output in JavaScript is Document.write.

questions.questionText: The physical layer concerns with:
questions.explanation: The physical layer is responsible for bit-by-bit delivery of data.

questions.questionText: What will be the output of the following program? #include using namespace std; int main (){ int i = 11; do { cout<<i<<endl; i++;} while( i<=10); return 0;}
questions.explanation: The output will be 11, as the do-while loop executes at least once before checking the condition. Since i=11 already exceeds the condition i<=10, the loop only executes once.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is correct syntax of variable declaration?
questions.explanation: Both B and C are correct syntax for variable declaration.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is true about knowledge?
options: Knowledge is created by the interaction of experience with information
Explicit knowledge is intangible, can be articulated, codified, stored: books, reports, journals, memos, documents; easily shared
Tacit knowledge is tangible; 'know-how' typically unwritten
questions.explanation: All statements are true regarding knowledge.

questions.questionText: Which one is not true about the file-based approach?
questions.explanation: In a file-based approach, data is typically not shared effectively.

questions.questionText: _________ is the process of placing the results of one's research into the literature.
questions.explanation: Academic publishing is the process of disseminating research results.

questions.questionText: A collection of terminals, computers, servers, and components that allows easy flow of data and use of resources between one another is called:
questions.explanation: A network is a collection of interconnected devices that facilitate data flow.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statement is false about PAL?
options: PAL uses 625 horizontal lines at a field rate of 50 fields per second
It is used in Australia, New Zealand, United Kingdom, and Europe.
For color representation, PAL uses YIQ color model.
In PAL, 5.5 MHz is allocated to Y, and 1.8 MHz each to U and V.
questions.explanation: PAL (Phase Alternating Line) uses the YUV color model, not YIQ. YIQ is used in the NTSC color television system. This makes option C false.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is correctly matched with their function?
options: DCL = define access control and privileges for users
questions.explanation: DCL (Data Control Language) is correctly matched with 'define access control and privileges for users'. DML (Data Manipulation Language) is for manipulating data, not just querying, and DDL (Data Definition Language) is for defining database schema, not just the database itself.

questions.questionText: From the following, all are characteristics of a system except?
questions.explanation: A system has boundaries; it does not exist without them.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not correct about forms?
options: Forms are used to pass data to the server
Forms are used to collect input from the user
Method is not an attribute of a form
Forms are a vital tool for webmasters to receive information
questions.explanation: Method is indeed an attribute of a form.

questions.questionText: From the following which one is true about information science?
options: It is the scientific study of information: how it is created, transmitted, encoded, transformed, retrieved, measured, used, and valued
It is inexorably connected to information technology
It is the science dealing with the efficient collection, storage, and retrieval of information
questions.explanation: All statements accurately describe information science.

questions.questionText: ________ is data that has been processed into a form that is meaningful to a recipient and is of perceived value in current or prospective decision making.
questions.explanation: Information is processed data that is meaningful and valuable for decision making. Data becomes information when it is contextualized, categorized, calculated and condensed.

questions.questionText: Which concept allows you to reuse the written code in C++?
questions.explanation: Inheritance allows for code reuse in C++.

questions.questionText: What is information literacy?
options: It is the ability to gather, organize, filter and evaluate information and to form valid opinions based on the results.
It is to move from text-based learning to resource-based learning
As a new liberal art that extends from knowing how to use computers and access information to critical reflection on the nature of information itself
questions.explanation: Information literacy encompasses all the mentioned abilities and skills.

questions.questionText: Is the process of editing a pre-existing bibliographic record instead of creating a completely new record from scratch?
questions.explanation: Copy cataloging involves editing existing bibliographic records.

questions.questionText: Which statement is correct for the boolean query (computer OR server) NOT mainframe?
options: Select all documents that discuss computers or servers, do not select any documents that discuss mainframes.
Select all documents that discuss computers, and do not discuss either servers or mainframes.
Select all documents that discuss computers, or documents that discuss servers but do not discuss mainframes.
Finds documents containing either computer, server or both.
questions.explanation: The boolean query '(computer OR server) NOT mainframe' retrieves documents that contain either 'computer' or 'server' (or both) but do not contain 'mainframe'. This is exactly what option A describes.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not true about HTML?
options: HTML is the backbone of the world wide web
HTML is the standard markup language for web pages.
HTML is used to store the document
questions.explanation: HTML is not used to store documents; it is a markup language for structuring content.

questions.questionText: What will be the output of the following program? #include using namespace std; int main(){ int x,b; x= 5; b=x--; cout<<b <<endl; cout<<x; return 0; }
questions.explanation: The output will be 5 for b and 4 for x after the post-decrement operation.

questions.questionText: A database consists of _________________________?
questions.explanation: A database consists of all three components: data (the actual stored information), relationships between the data (how different pieces of data are connected), and restrictions (constraints that maintain data integrity).

questions.questionText: Words with special meaning to the compiler and have a predefined meaning that can't be changed are called:
questions.explanation: Keywords are reserved words in programming languages with predefined meanings.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following user authorization is dealing with permission to add as well as delete attributes?
questions.explanation: Alteration Authorization deals with permissions to add and delete attributes in a database. This typically involves ALTER TABLE privileges in SQL database systems.

questions.questionText: Which of the following correctly declares an array in C++?
questions.explanation: The correct way to declare an array in C++ is 'int array[10];'.

questions.questionText: __________________ is a term used to denote a set of instructions which is designed so as to enable the computer hardware functioning.
questions.explanation: Software refers to the set of instructions that enable hardware to function.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not true about C++ programming?
options: C++ supports both procedural and object-oriented programming languages
questions.explanation: C++ is a high-level programming language, not a machine language.

questions.questionText: Which section helps with your literature search?
questions.explanation: The References section is crucial for literature searches.

questions.questionText: Which HTML tag is used to add a row in the table?
questions.explanation: <tr> is the tag used to define a row in an HTML table.

questions.questionText: Tags and text that are not directly displayed on the page are written in _____ section.
questions.explanation: The <head> section contains metadata and scripts not displayed on the page.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is a characteristic of gray-scale images?
options: Each image pixel is stored as a single bit (0 or 1)
Supports 256 shades of gray, with each pixel typically using 8 bits
Each pixel is represented by three bytes
A 640 x 480 gray-scale image requires 37.5 KB of storage
questions.explanation: Gray-scale images typically support 256 shades of gray, with each pixel represented by 8 bits (1 byte), allowing values from 0-255.

questions.questionText: If x>5 and y<4, what is the boolean value of x < 5 || y < 4?
questions.explanation: The expression evaluates to True. Since y<4 is true, and the OR operator (||) requires only one condition to be true, the entire expression is true even though x<5 is false.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the correct logical step in the information retrieval process?
options: First user specifies a user need => Next the query operations are applied => The query is then processed => The user then examines the set of ranked documents.
First the query operations are applied => Next the user information need specified => The query is then processed => The user then examines the set of ranked documents.
First the query is processed => Next the query operations are applied => The user then examines the set of ranked documents => Next the user information need specified.
First the user examines the set of ranked documents => Next the query operations are applied => then the query is processed => then the user information need specified.
questions.explanation: The correct logical sequence starts with the user specifying their need.

questions.questionText: Why Automated Library Catalogue?
questions.explanation: All options highlight the benefits of an automated library catalog.

questions.questionText: The word 'Hello' is made up of 5 characters. How many bits is this (hint: how many 1's and 0's are needed to write it)?
questions.explanation: Each character typically requires 8 bits in ASCII or Unicode encoding, so 5 characters require 5 × 8 = 40 bits.

questions.questionText: What protects the intellectual property created by inventors?
questions.explanation: Patents protect the intellectual property of inventors.

questions.questionText: What is the output of the following code? static void Main(string[] args) { int i = 30; int j = 25 % 25; if (Convert.ToBoolean(Convert.ToInt32(i = j))) { Console.WriteLine('C# programming'); } else { Console.WriteLine('Advanced programming'); } Console.WriteLine('object oriented'); Console.ReadLine(); }
options: C# programming, Advanced programming and object oriented
questions.explanation: Since j is 0 (25 % 25 = 0), i becomes 0. Convert.ToBoolean(0) is false in C#, so the else branch executes, printing 'Advanced programming' followed by 'object oriented'.

questions.questionText: If int x=10, what is the value of x+=5?
questions.explanation: The value of x becomes 15 after the operation x+=5.

questions.questionText: From the following one is not an element of communication:
questions.explanation: All options are elements of communication.

questions.questionText: Which one is false about the nature and properties of information?
questions.explanation: None of the statements are false about the nature of information. Information is indeed endless (continuing to grow without limit), compressible (can be condensed or summarized), and expandable (can be elaborated upon with details).

questions.questionText: What is the index number of the last element of an array with 9 elements?
questions.explanation: The index of the last element in an array of 9 elements is 8.

questions.questionText: What is the output value of the following code? using System; namespace MyApplication {class Program { static void Main(string[] args) { double x = 10.25; Console.Write(Convert.ToInt32(x)); } } }
questions.explanation: The output will be 10, as the double is converted to an integer.

questions.questionText: In which type of transmission can data be transmitted in both directions at the same time?
questions.explanation: Full-duplex transmission allows data to be sent in both directions simultaneously.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not the importance of information literacy?
options: To understand the difficult question of ownership of information and copyright.
Students should learn to respect author's rights.
Help to increase the gap between the information poor and the information rich.
questions.explanation: Information literacy aims to decrease (not increase) the gap between information-rich and information-poor individuals. Increasing this gap would be counterproductive to the goals of information literacy.

questions.questionText: Library Management System has been intended to_______________
options: Creating different Reports for Record-Keeping and Review purposes
Calculating/Managing Fine and Balances of installments due from Members
questions.explanation: All options describe the functions of a Library Management System.

questions.questionText: How do structures and classes in C++ differ?
options: Structures by default hide every member whereas classes do not.
In Structures, members are public by default whereas, in Classes, they are private by default.
Structures cannot have private members whereas classes can have.
In Structures, members are private by default whereas, in Classes, they are public by default.
questions.explanation: In C++, structures have public members by default, while classes have private members.

questions.questionText: Uniform Titles Are Used If:
options: More Than One Work Has The Same Title And A Qualifier Is Needed To Distinguish One From Another
Work Is A Complicated One, Divided Into Parts With Titles Of Their Own
A Work Is Important For Religious, Historical, Literary, Or Other Reasons
questions.explanation: Uniform titles are used in all the mentioned scenarios.

questions.questionText: A collection of linked Web pages that has a common theme or focus is called:
questions.explanation: A website is a collection of linked web pages with a common theme.

questions.questionText: Huffman trees use the _______________ of each character to work out their encoding.
questions.explanation: Huffman trees use the frequency of characters to determine their encoding.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the knowledge that people carry in their minds and is, therefore, difficult to access?
questions.explanation: Tacit knowledge is personal and difficult to formalize or communicate.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a characteristic of a good database?
questions.explanation: A good database should maintain consistency in data.
